text: DigiKey offers net-30 payment with a minimum order value of USD 250. Mouser offers net-45 for approved accounts. Quotes are valid for 14 days.
Alpha Dynamics Ltd requests a quotation for 2,500 units of the NAV-9 flight controller board. Internal tracking reference ZEBRA-7731. Required delivery: 2026-12-01 to the Austin, TX facility.
The assembly must meet IPC-A-610 Class 3 and AS9100D. Rocketreach Pvt. Ltd. will act as the Tier-1 EMS contract manufacturer for the programme.
Pricing basis: live costing with FX as-of the quotation date; scrap rate 1.5 percent.
